hero.title: AI Agent Implementation for Businesses in Spain
hero.description:
We design, build, and deploy Claude-powered AI agents for business operations. An AI agent is software that can perceive context, reason through it, and take action - connecting to your tools, processing your data, and executing tasks without manual intervention. Unlike simple automations, agents handle ambiguity, multi-step decisions, and unstructured inputs.
We build agents powered by Claude, Anthropic's most capable and safest AI model.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about AI agents

items.question: How much does it cost to implement a Claude AI agent for a business in Spain?
items.answer: Implementation cost depends on complexity. A basic agent (document processing or internal Q&A) starts at €8,000–15,000. More complex projects with multiple integrations typically range from €20,000–50,000. Contact us for a free, no-commitment estimate.

items.question: How long does it take to implement an AI agent?
items.answer: Average implementation time is 4 to 8 weeks from kickoff to production. More complex projects may take 10–16 weeks. We work in iterative sprints so you see real results from week 2–3.

items.question: What makes Gigson Solutions different from other AI companies?
items.answer: We are a Certified Anthropic Partner - one of the few in Spain - with direct access to technical support and the latest Claude models. We don't sell demos or abandoned POCs: we deliver production agents with ongoing support and full traceability.

items.question: What does my company need to start using AI agents?
items.answer: No special infrastructure required. Agents connect to your existing tools (ERP, CRM, email, documents). We start with a free diagnostic to identify the highest-impact, lowest-friction use case for your team.

items.question: Are Claude agents safe for confidential business data?
items.answer: Yes. Anthropic's Claude is designed with a safety-first approach. Data is not used to train models. We can deploy agents on your own infrastructure (on-premise or private cloud) for greater control. We comply with GDPR and can support compliance processes.

Integrated dashboard for real-time tracking of project progress, providing client visibility and internal time reporting.
Automation of invoicing and accounts receivable tracking within the project workflow.
Coordination of purchases and budgets through the integrated ERP platform.
Profitability analysis of projects and portfolio management of services.

faqsDropdown.question: What is a custom digital product?
faqsDropdown.answer: A digital product meets the needs of users, business objectives, and market opportunities to provide the best solution to the customer. It differs from standard solutions in that it adapts to the specific processes and tools of the client, offering greater flexibility and efficiency.

faqsDropdown.question: How do you ensure you understand what I need?
faqsDropdown.answer: Our process begins with discovery and analysis meetings where we delve into use cases to ensure we understand all the needs before starting development.

faqsDropdown.question: Why choose a custom software solution instead of a standard one?
faqsDropdown.answer: Standard solutions are often generic for any type of business, usually include unnecessary functions that complicate their use, and are not easily "integrated" with other solutions that may already be integrated. A custom solution is designed to integrate perfectly with your way of working, improving productivity and efficiency.

faqsDropdown.question: Will I have support and maintenance when development is finished?
faqsDropdown.answer: Of course! If you want us to take care of maintenance and support, we will do so as we have a dedicated team for it where we will be delighted to solve any problems that may arise.

faqsDropdown.question: Who will develop my solution?
faqsDropdown.answer: At Gigson Solutions, we have different collaborators specialized in each part of the process to provide a complete service adapted to the needs of the client such as software development, usability, marketing, and graphic, legal, etc.

faqsDropdown.question: Will I own my solution?
faqsDropdown.answer: If you want, you can be the sole owner of the product we develop to gain a competitive advantage.

faqsDropdown.question: What is the difference between Gigson Solutions and hiring a developer?
faqsDropdown.answer: The main difference is that a developer will implement what you think, define, and prioritize. It is rare for them to ask aspects like whether it is really what the business needs, the pricing model, or the security of the information.

faqsDropdown.question: How is security and privacy handled in new products?
faqsDropdown.answer: Security and privacy are a priority in all our solutions. We adopt secure coding practices and can certify the products we develop following standards like GDPR, SOC2, or HIPAA.

faqsDropdown.question: Can I coordinate the product development myself?
faqsDropdown.answer: Yes, however, we do not recommend it as a lack of experience in managing technical teams can lead to communication misunderstandings, poor risk management, and resource management.

faqsDropdown.question: Have we left anything unanswered?
faqsDropdown.answer: We'll be happy to address any other questions you may have. You can reach out to us at info@gigsonsolutions.com or through our contact form.

items.question: How can AI improve my company's logistics operations?
items.answer: AI agents can automate high-volume, low-value tasks: transport document classification, order tracking, incident management, carrier communication and report generation. The average result is a 30–50% reduction in operational time on these processes.

items.question: What technology integrations are common for logistics companies?
items.answer: The most frequent are: ERP ↔ WMS integration, connection with tracking platforms (FedEx, DHL, MRW), marketplace integration (Amazon, Shopify), EDI automation, and connectors with proprietary warehouse management systems. We work with both legacy and modern systems.

items.question: How long does a logistics digitalization project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A single integration (e.g. connecting ERP with a carrier platform) takes 3–6 weeks. A broader digital transformation project can take 3–6 months with iterative phases. We always start with the highest-impact process to show quick results.

seo.description: We implement your ISO 27001 ISMS on your real operations, without bureaucracy. Free diagnosis in 24h for SMEs, law firms and consultancies.

hero.sub: We implement an Information Security Management System (ISMS) on your real operations - not documentation nobody will ever use. For small and medium-sized businesses - a law firm, a consultancy, an agency, a tech SME - that need the certificate without grinding their day-to-day to a halt.
hero.note: No commitment · We tell you which controls you already meet without knowing it

pain.card1title: Your client requires it to keep working with you
pain.card1p: More and more mid-size and large companies include ISO 27001 as a contractual requirement for their suppliers. It's not optional: either you get certified or you lose the contract.
pain.card2title: The tender scores it or requires it outright
pain.card2p: In public and private tenders, having ISO 27001 earns points or is a mandatory requirement. Competing without it means ceding ground to those who already have it.
pain.card3title: Every sale stalls on a security questionnaire
pain.card3p: Your clients - especially regulated ones or those with NIS2 behind them - send increasingly demanding security questionnaires. Without ISO 27001, each questionnaire is weeks of work; with it, a single answer.
pain.card4p: More than 3,000 Spanish companies are certified in ISO 27001. In more and more sectors, certification is already a de facto standard - not a differentiator.

diff.lead: Most ISO consultancies write documents. We implement controls on your real operations - the systems, accesses and processes you already use every day - and leave you with an ISMS that actually works, not one that just passes the audit.
diff.item1p: We assess how your company truly works - systems, accesses, data, suppliers, critical processes - and implement the Annex A controls on what you already have.
diff.item2title: A minimum viable system, easy to maintain
diff.item2p: We know many companies have no security officer - or even an IT team in some cases. We design the simplest ISMS that passes the audit: no unnecessary bureaucracy, easy to maintain even if security is handled by someone who already has five things on their plate.
diff.item3title: We know what is certifiable and what is not
diff.item3p: We won't sell you certification on everything. NIS2, for example, is not a certification - it's compliance; ISO 27001 is. We explain exactly what you need based on your situation, without over-engineering or unnecessary paperwork.

process.lead: A process designed for SMEs: diagnosis of your real operations, implementation on what you already have, and coordination with the certification body - without grinding your day-to-day to a halt.
process.step1p: Gap analysis of your current situation. We identify which controls you already meet without knowing it and what is actually missing.
process.step2p: Documentation, risk analysis, operational controls on what you already have, and training for the team involved.
process.step3p: Pre-certification check so you go into the external audit with certification assured.
process.step4p: We coordinate the phase 1 and phase 2 audits with the certification body. ISO 27001 certificate obtained.
